title: AssertionStatusResponse
description: Response for GET /api/outputs/:id/assertion-status (HEL-576, retargeted HEL-906). `invalid` is true when the Output's owning pipeline node's (HEL-906: `stepId`-scoped, not the retired DataType's) latest NON-DRY run has at least one persisted error-severity failed assertion -- a dry run is never considered. `failedRuleCount` is the count of such failures.
